check cpu, nvidia gtx 1650 gpu and ram status

**Linux**
```bash
# CPU details
lscpu
cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep 'model name' | uniq
# RAM usage
free -h
cat /proc/meminfo | grep MemTotal
# NVIDIA GTX 1650 status
nvidia-smi
```
**Windows (PowerShell)**
```powershell
# CPU
Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name,NumberOfCores,NumberOfLogicalProcessors
# RAM
Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PhysicalMemory | Measure-Object -Property Capacity -Sum |
ForEach-Object { "{0:N2} GB" -f ($_.Sum/1GB) }
# GPU (GTX 1650)
Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\cimv2 -ClassName Win32_VideoController |
Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*1650*" } |
Select-Object Name,DriverVersion,AdapterRAM
```

```bash

ls -la
# View the first few lines of a file
head -n 20 filename.txt
# Search for a keyword inside files
grep -R "search_term" .
```
**Windows PowerShell**
```powershell
# List files and directories
Get-ChildItem -Force
# View the first few lines of a file
Get-Content -Path .\filename.txt -TotalCount 20
# Search for a keyword inside files
Select-String -Path *.txt -Pattern "search_term"
```
